item.title: Karmelo Anthony’s attorney asks judge for new trial in Texas track meet killing
item.description: The attorney for a Texas teenager convicted of fatally stabbing a track athlete during a high school meet has told a judge that he deserves a new trial because the court wrongly limited access to earlier proceedings.
